title: Stabilize runner pinmap and probe harness to improve tokens/sec fidelity and regression detection
creator: Alex Chen
description: Problem: Our tokens/sec and p95 throughput numbers show noise across CI runs due to inconsistent driver/CUDA/image combinations and non-deterministic runner startup probes. Goal: Create a deterministic 'pinmap' that maps runner flavors to an approved set of GPU drivers, CUDA toolkits, and immutable container images, and implement a lightweight probe harness that verifies environment compatibility and warms KV caches before benchmark collection. This reduces variance, surfaces real regressions, and avoids false positives from environment drift. Deliverables: a pinmap YAML used by benchmark CI and local runners, probe harness binary and orchestration script, CI gating rule that blocks commits with incompatible images, updated docs and migration notes for the benchmark owners.
acceptance_criteria: Pinmap exists mapping each runner type to a single approved driver version, CUDA toolkit, and image digest
Probe harness returns a deterministic compatibility signature and warms KV/cache for a canonical prompt set
CI benchmark job retries only on infra-level failures and flags parametric regressions when tokens/sec change >3% p95 across stable images
Historical benchmark noise reduced: standard deviation of tokens/sec across 10 runs falls by at least 40% for target models
Migration doc published and at least two benchmark teams have migrated their runner configs to pinmap entries
tasks: Draft pinmap schema and validation rules (YAML + JSON schema)
Inventory current runner flavors and recorded driver/CUDA combos from benchmark logs
Build probe harness: environment checks, small inference warmup, KV cache priming, compatibility signature output
Integrate probe harness into benchmark CI pre-step and gate on signature mismatch
Add a CI policy to mark runs as 'environment-variant' vs 'regression' using probe output
Create migration guide and deprecation plan for unpinned images
Add grafana dashboard panels to show per-run probe signature and image digest alongside tokens/sec and p95
test_plan: Unit tests for pinmap validator and schema against sample runner manifests
End-to-end test: run probe harness on each runner type in staging and assert deterministic signature and non-empty KV cache
Benchmark stability test: run canonical throughput job 20x across pinned images and compute stddev and p95 variance
Regression injection test: intentionally change driver on a staging runner to verify CI flags environment-variant and not a code regression
Canary rollout: enable pinmap-enforcement for a single benchmark suite and monitor for false positives using slack alerts and dashboard
notes: Design decision: prefer image digest pinning over tag pinning to eliminate upstream tag drift
Trade-off: strict pinning increases ops overhead for upgrades; include scheduled 'pinmap rotation' process with smoke tests
Related work: leverages the benchmark environment contract defined in ENG-14237 and driver alignment in ENG-21844
We will adopt a lightweight signing mechanism for probe signatures to detect silent infra changes
Keep the probe harness <50ms added latency to the benchmark run startup; heavy warmups must be separated from per-run probes
